title: Loot Profile Definition
description: Schema for shared reusable loot-profile definitions. Used by sections.storage.lootProfileId so objects stay exact by default and reusable randomization lives in one place.

profileId.description: Stable loot profile identifier used for FPrimaryAssetId lookup. RENAME WARNING: Referenced by object definitions via sections.storage.lootProfileId. Mismatch causes silent empty containers.

pickCountMin.description: Minimum unique entry picks from this profile

pickCountMax.description: Maximum unique entry picks from this profile

objectId.description: ObjectDefinition PrimaryAssetId (e.g. 'ObjectDefinition:WaterBottle'). RENAME WARNING: Must match object definition id field. Mismatch causes silent spawn failure.
